map.排查缓存问题：用 TTL 查键的剩余有效期、用 SCAN 安全遍历（避免 KEY: Troubleshoot cache issues: use TTL to check a key's remaining lifetime, use SCAN for safe traversal (avoid KEYS blocking the main thread), and confirm the cache expires as expected.

map.为什么线上不能用 KEYS？: Why is KEYS forbidden in production?
map.因为 KEYS 会一次性遍历整个键空间，时间复杂度 O(N)，在百万级键的实例上: Because KEYS traverses the entire key space at once, with O(N) complexity; on instances with millions of keys it blocks the main thread for tens of milliseconds to seconds, queuing all requests. Use SCAN for incremental traversal (batched by cursor, non-blocking) and the count parameter to control each scan's size. Disabling KEYS in production is recommended.
